sidebar.api_key.label: API Key
sidebar.api_key.help: Kept only for this session - never logged, saved, or exported.
sidebar.timeouts.caption: NVIDIA Build (free tier) can queue for several minutes before the first token.
sidebar.test.caption: Loads the model catalog first (checks the key), then a short test call to a small model from it.
sidebar.test.no_model_found: No suitable model found in the catalog.
sidebar.test.queue_status: in NVIDIA's queue - waiting for {elapsed:.0f} s ...
sidebar.test.prompt: Answer in one word: test successful.
sidebar.test.unavailable_trying_next: {model}: not available for this account - trying next model ...
sidebar.availability.help: Mini call (max_tokens=1) to every catalog model, in parallel, short timeout.
sidebar.pricing.caption: Only enter a price if you can verify it on an official provider page - with source and date. Leave unknown prices empty (shown as '-', not 0). Genuinely free models: tick "Free" instead of entering 0 - unknown and free are not the same.
sidebar.pricing.col_free_help: Genuinely free tier, not just an unknown price.
sidebar.rag.disabled_caption: Disabled - prompts go to the models without your own documents.
sidebar.rag.no_key_caption: RAG needs the NVIDIA Build API key (embeddings).
sidebar.rag.no_embed_model: No embedding model found in the catalog.
sidebar.rag.not_indexed_caption: No document indexed yet - the run will go without context.
sidebar.rag.embed_mismatch: The existing index was built with embedding model '{stored}', not '{requested}'. Clear the index first to switch models.
sidebar.rag.embed_check_help: Mini embedding call to every catalog embedding model, in parallel, short timeout.
sidebar.rag.embed_404_hint: {name}: this embedding model was rejected (404) - please choose a different embedding model.
sidebar.footer: NVIDIA Build · Key kept only for this session, never stored.
main.models.no_key_caption: Enter your API key (sidebar) to load the model catalog.
main.models.many_models_caption: From 5 models onward, NVIDIA Build (free tier) can take longer overall (parallel, but capped) - not a hard limit, just a heads-up.
main.warning_rag_not_ready: RAG is enabled, but no document has been indexed yet - the run will go without context.
main.run.status.queue: - {model} · {prompt}: in NVIDIA's queue - waiting for {elapsed:.0f} s
main.results.dropped_param_caption: Some models had a parameter removed after a 400 error and were retried without it - affected: {models}. Details per card/export.
main.results.cost_caption: Estimated total cost of this run: ${cost} (your prices from the model list above){note}
main.results.cost_unknown_note: (plus {count} answer(s) with unknown price, not included)
main.timeline.no_runs_caption: No saved runs yet — the history will appear here after the first benchmark.
main.timeline.metric_help: Generation time/tokens per second reflect model performance - the total latency on NVIDIA Build (free tier) mostly reflects the queue.
main.timeline.no_values_caption: No values yet for this metric on the selected models.
main.timeline.footer_caption: {count} run(s) saved. Requires the provider to keep the model ID stable — a rename breaks the time series.
main.timeline.mixed_params_caption: Not directly comparable: {models} have runs with different prompt text or different parameters (temperature/top_p/max_tokens) in their history - the timeline shows separate lines in the same colour for these.
error.no_first_token: Timeout: no first token after {seconds} s (queue?).
error.no_further_token: Timeout: no further token for {seconds} s.
error.rate_limit: Rate limit reached on NVIDIA Build (429) - wait a moment and try again.
error.not_found: Model not found or not available for this account (404).
error.gone: Model no longer available (410) - please choose another model.
error.transport_timeout: Transport-level timeout - no response from NVIDIA Build.
error.connection: Could not connect to NVIDIA Build (network).
error.api: Could not connect to NVIDIA Build.
error.unknown: Unknown error during the API call.
error.unavailable_for_account: In the catalog, but not available for this account.
